title: decachaena baccata
intro: Decachaena baccata, commonly known as the Indian plum or hog plum, is a plant species native to the tropical and subtropical regions of Asia. The Indian plum has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing fever, treating diarrhea, and providing relief from respiratory issues such as coughs and colds. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and act as a natural expectorant. The bioactive constituents of Decachaena baccata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
